value.title: Copilot native extension cutover
value.summary: PM-owned task contract; three isolated Astra units, serial composition and independent Opus review.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Use impl-guide.dd.json as the frozen contract. No product edits outside fence; no global deploy; source paths absolute. Baseline typecheck passed; harness boot failed existing file-watch-notify smoke before implementation. Do not suppress or fix unrelated baseline failures. A fresh implementation smoke remains required.

value.title: Contract fixtures and baseline
value.success: Record baseline and pin focused regression cases before source edits: initial/drain zero-tmux for extension Copilot, correct native identity, ack grade, duplicate suppression, consent hold and recovery. Preserve existing failures as baseline.
value.notes: PM contracts + all coders scoped baseline; see impl-guide unit fence and assets/contracts/native-extension.json

value.title: Exclusive daemon ownership and identity
value.success: Native Copilot registration attests capability against exact observed process incarnation; initial arrival and DrainWorker never type for Copilot after cutover; claim admission honors current consent gate and safe wake/retry, while Pi/OMP/Claude are unchanged.

value.title: Native user extension and outgoing messages
value.success: Repo-managed JavaScript module joins current session using bundled SDK, establishes identity, exposes native outgoing Pij send tool, processes one blocking claim/send/ack at a time and observes events with no automatic reply loop.
value.notes: extension; see impl-guide unit fence and assets/contracts/native-extension.json

value.title: Reconnect and native lifecycle
value.success: Spawn correlation, manual identity, new/resume/reload, daemon key refresh/reconnect, pending claims and native accepted-message ledger are exercised; old consumer cancellation and explicit ambiguity diagnostic prevent wrong-session or blind duplicate delivery.
value.notes: extension with daemon lifecycle contract; see impl-guide unit fence and assets/contracts/native-extension.json

value.title: Managed installation and doctor
value.success: Canonical-main install/link/update surfaces install reviewed artifact into resolved Copilot home, merge experimental setting safely, preserve foreign paths and user values, expose clear doctor result; isolated-home tests prove repeatability.

value.success: Copilot UI-server/port allocator/intents and active fallback branches are removed across all callers; historical migrations remain, any new schema change is forward-only. Native controls work where supported; unsupported controls are explicit rather than queued forever or typed.

tk-0001.assertion: Frozen wire/file fixtures and expected positive/negative outcomes are committed and referenced by all three unit packets.
Baseline commands and exact results are recorded, including existing smoke failure, and scoped unit test entrypoints are assigned.

tk-0002.assertion: A new Copilot CLI started manually in tmux with no Pij env or RPC flags auto-loads the extension, registers truthful copilot/native-session/process/pane identity and can receive and send Pij messages.

A Pij-spawned new Copilot session uses the same installed extension, binds the preallocated seat/spawn correlation exactly once, receives initial task once, and sends replies with the same Pij identity.

Every Copilot delivery path including first arrival, drain, retry and control commands avoids tmux submit/sendkeys/paste; missing or disabled extension is visibly queued/refused and never silently falls back. Pi/OMP/Claude contracts remain unchanged.

Human draft/typing veto holds Copilot delivery without altering the composer; the admitted case subsequently delivers once after the existing consent policy permits it. Both worlds have tangible real-client evidence.
